recruitment: Telangana Police Recruitment 2026 — SCT SI (Civil) and equivalent posts
purpose: The official syllabus as a strict Subject -> Topic -> Subtopic hierarchy, one record per node, every node traceable to a retrieved official document.
blocked_reason: No official TGPRB / TSLPRB document has been retrieved, so no syllabus node can be created. Network egress from this environment permits one unrelated host; see source_material/official/RETRIEVAL_LOG.md and blocker B-09.
empty_is_correct_because: An empty official syllabus is the honest state when no official document has been read. A populated one written from model recall or coaching material would be T4_AI or T3_EXPERT content wearing a T1_OFFICIAL label, which CLAUDE.md section 5 identifies as the most serious content error possible in this project.

node_shape.parent_id: node_id of the level above; null only for a subject
node_shape.paper: which examination paper this node belongs to (PWT / FWE paper identifier as the notification names it)
node_shape.title: verbatim wording from the official document
node_shape.title_te: Telugu companion field (D-0004); a translation of sourced wording, never an independent claim
node_shape.ordinal: position within its parent, preserving the document's own order

rules: parent_id must resolve to an existing node whose level is exactly one above.
A node exists only if provenance.document_id names a document whose retrieval_status is RETRIEVED.
title is the official wording. Do not tidy it, expand abbreviations, or merge two listed items into one node.
The document's own ordering is preserved in ordinal, because order sometimes signals emphasis.

A topic that coaching institutes teach but the official document does not name is NOT a node here. It belongs in knowledge/preparation_taxonomy/, linked by official_anchor or marked NO_OFFICIAL_ANCHOR.

If the official document gives only subject headings with no topic breakdown, then the official syllabus has exactly those subjects and no topics. Inventing a topic layer to look complete is prohibited.
